# Pull Request

## Summary

Describe the change and the learning or engineering problem it addresses.

## Change Type

- [ ] Lesson or documentation
- [ ] Code example
- [ ] Test or CI
- [ ] Dependency or version policy
- [ ] Security improvement
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Repository maintenance

## Validation

- [ ] I used the repository's supported Node.js baseline.
- [ ] Relevant examples run successfully.
- [ ] Tests pass where available.
- [ ] Lint and build checks pass where available.
- [ ] Imports, commands, paths, and links were checked.
- [ ] No secrets, personal data, or confidential information are included.
- [ ] Dependency changes and lockfile changes were reviewed.
- [ ] Security and compatibility impacts are documented.
- [ ] New or changed educational content is original or properly attributed.
- [ ] The contribution is compatible with the MIT License.

## Test Evidence

List commands run and summarize results.

## Documentation Impact

List README, module, version-policy, migration, or reference files updated.

## Risks and Follow-up

Describe known limitations, migration needs, or work intentionally left out.
